verdict.rationale: Capacities hosts an interactive API reference at api.capacities.io/docs. It renders the published OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec and lets you make authenticated try-it requests by pasting a Bearer token, and the successor portal at developers.capacities.io advertises an interactive OpenAPI spec with TypeScript SDK samples. The probe 404s were on docs.capacities.io paths, not where the spec is hosted, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the try-it dashboard works, and continuity, since the current Beta reference is discontinued September 1, 2026 and the successor portal's runnable samples are evidenced only by a vendor description.
